notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/6435edd4f66d4238fcfddba40b98b04f7358acde.jpg[/img]

[b]New Feature - Warhost Raids[/b]
Raids are a new type of enemy that will appear on the World Map. These enemies will appear larger on the World Map, typically filling a 3x3 area.

These are Alliance exclusive locations, which when defeated, can yield new rewards and loot.

The first of the Warhost Raids, in which prides of Frenzied Manticores soaring from the World’s Edge Mountains attack the Old World in the Manticore Rampage event.

[b]Additional Structure Levels[/b]

Seven structures have had their maximum level increased from 35 to 38. These are:
[list]
[*]Watch Tower
[*]Drinking Hole
[*]War Council
[*]Temple of Khorne
[*]Temple of Nurgle
[*]Temple of Tzeentch
[*]Temple of Slaanesh
[/list]

Each of these structures has had new objectives added for these 3 new levels.

[b]Additional Loadouts[/b]
2 new Equipment and 2 new March Loadouts are now available, they can be researched from the Mastery Tree.

[b]New Rituals[/b]
The following new Rituals have been added to the Mastery Ritual Tree:
[list]
[*]Equipment Loadout V
[*]Equipment Loadout VI
[*]March Formation V
[*]March Formation VI
[/list]
Each of these Rituals has had a new objective added.

[b]New Craftable Item[/b]

The Tusk Amulet has been added to the game.
To craft this new item, you’ll need to obtain Manticore Tusks from Manticore Raids.

[b]Daily Trials[/b]
Daily Trial rewards have been rotated, to now give Ilthmar Shards and Azazel Shards as a reward for completing 18 Daily Trials

[b]Event Improvements[/b]
A number of Events have had their Leaderboards and Rewards adjusted.

notes.title: Game Update 3.8 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Game Update 3.8 is here, bringing 2 new events, 5 new item pieces, revamped challenges, Empire City improvements, structure, ritual, and Warlord upgrades. Players can now complete their Barrow Armour set by engaging in the new ‘On Rotten Wings’ event! 

 Here are the full patch notes for update 3.8:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/96eecfffb17aab9507ffa03891eeb331b6a1fb2e.png[/img]

[b]On Rotting Wings[/b]

A new event, ‘On Rotting Wings’ will be added to the game. In this event, Terrorgheists disturbed from their lairs descend upon tattered wings, their lethal screams heralding doom!

Across the Old World, the Terrorghiest can be found, these elite foes will be appearing at levels 8, 9 and 10. These rotting giant bats are a severe threat and will need to be tackled by only the strongest of Chaos Champions.

The Terrorgheist will potentially drop a Decayed Wing Membrane, which can be used in turn to craft the final 2 pieces of the Barrow armour set, Gauntlets and Plate Armour. The Barrow set has also been improved with additional set bonuses.


[b]New Event - Scourge of Chaos[/b]

Across the Old World, resources of all types will be looted and pillaged by the forces of Chaos.

A new cross-region gain resource challenge will be added which will run during this event, expect to see level 10 and above resource nodes across the Old World.

[b]Item Updates[/b]

[i]Added 3 new pieces of equipment to the Ritualist Set:[/i]
🔸 Ritualist Sceptre
🔸 Ritualist Boots
🔸 Ritualist Scroll

[i]Changed two stats on the Ritualist Cuirass:[/i]
🔸 Monstrous Infantry Melee Damage & Monstrous Infantry Ranged Damage both now scale from 1% - 15%

[b]Added Structure Levels[/b]

🔸 Drinking Hole
🔸 Trading Post
🔸 Sawbones

[b]New Ritual[/b]

🔸 Bane of the Undead

[b]Objectives[/b]

🔸 Added new Objectives for the above Structure levels and the Undead Ritual.

[b]Daily Reward[/b]

🔸 Slambo is no longer available from the daily login reward, going forward you’ll be able to obtain Throgg shards for the foreseeable future.

[b]Warlord Improvement[/b]

🔸 Karanak has joined the rank of Legendary Warlords with a 5th stat when reaching Skull Rank 6. This stat is Khorne Melee Attack and at maximum level will provide a 45% bonus.

[b]New Challenges[/b]

[i]A new version of the following challenges has been added:[/i]

🔸 Region Wars
🔸 City Siege

Here are the full patch notes for [b]Game Update 3.7[/b], released today! 💀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/64c49651e4abc9cc666f542e773046ada0103348.png[/img]

[h3]New Content[/h3]

A new event, ‘The Barrows Rise’ has been added to the game. In this event, Dark Magic gathers and stirs the dead in their graves! Ancient Warriors swarm across the old world, awakened by Necromancers practicing their cursed magical arts.

Across the Old World, hordes of Skeleton Warriors will be appearing at levels 15, 25 and 35, clad in their corroded armour, their lifeless hand’s still gripping the weapons they held in life. These skeletal warriors obey their Vampire masters. 

These new high-level Armies will potentially drop Accursed Sword Shards which can be used in turn to craft 2 additional pieces of the Barrow armour set, Helm and Greaves.


[h3]Event Changes and Improvements[/h3]

A new version of the Undivided Warpstone Devour event has been added in which Harald Hammerstorm is featured prominently within the tier and top list rewards.

Added new equipment to the Runesmith event:

[list]
[*] Corrupted Runic Gauntlets
[*] Corrupted Runic Axe
[*] Corrupted Runic Boots
[/list]
Added new equipment to Barrow Set:
[list]
[*] Greaves of the Barrow
[*] Helm of the Barrow
[/list]

New High-Level Greenskin Armies have been added to the Greenskin Aggression event, these are available to battle at levels 15, 25, and 35.


[h3]Keep Skin Improvements[/h3]
Improved the following Keep skins by adding additional buffs when equipped:
[list]
[*] Blighted Stronghold, reduced Healing Resource Costs.
[*] Exalted Hellcannon Fortress, added Undivided Ranged Damage.
[*] Gore Fountain, added Troop Training Speed.
[/list]

[h3]Crafted Item Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked all existing items to no longer only have stats on them that only boost the player’s Champion, in all situations, they will now boost everything within the march if the Champion is present.
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blocked players' messages will no longer be visible in World Chat.
[*] Added the Skull of the Damned as a tradable currency at the Raider’s Market.
[*] Players can recruit multiple of the same warlord at once
[*] Added a toggle to select whether “March Gather Yield” selects enough units to fully clear resource tiles or leave a small amount remaining.
[*] The number of Warpstone on the leaderboard placings for the Legendary Warlord challenges has been adjusted to allow more challenges to be run during these special weekend events.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[/list]

notes.title: New Release - Game Update 3.5!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/99875e40ad8b501687072f86f086ef0286ce7a16.png[/img]

Greetings, Lord of Chaos! Today we have the full patch notes for Game Update 3.5 to share with you all.

[h3]Patch Notes - Game Update 3.5[/h3]

Harald Hammerstorm arrives in the Old World with the return of our Celebration of Slaughter to celebrate the Third Year Anniversary of the game! Power up your Undivided troops with new Rituals, craft new gear and level your Fortress even further! Full Patch Notes available in-game.


[b]New Warlord[/b]

Hammerstorm will soon move across the Old World in the ‘God Hammer’ event, allowing players to earn his allegiance in battle. Harald is an Undivided Legendary Warlord and he will bring the following buffs to his marches:
[list]
[*] Infantry Health: 2.5% to 45%
[*] Undivided Melee Damage: 2.5% to 45%
[*] Undivided Armoure: 2.5% to 45%
[*] Fortress Combat Bonus: 1% to 18%
[*] Undivided Ranged Damage: 10% to 30%
[/list]
Hararld is the first of the Warlords to join the game who has 5 buffs, the fifth one becoming available at the sixth skull rank!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/07ba474ea52f16ffd05ff92179c9a419bd03bafd.jpg[/img]

Harald will be available to unlock instantly at Rank 6 via a Warpstone purchase in the Shop.


[b]Undivided Improvements[/b]

Six new rituals are being added to the Undivided ritual tree. These have been designed to bring additional power to the Undivided units within your Fortresses and allow them to compete with God-Aligned units! The Rituals will increase your Undivided stats by the following:

🔸 Undivided Armour - 47%
🔸 Undivided Health - 30%
🔸 Undivided Ranged Attack - 25%
🔸 Undivided Ranged Damage - 10%
🔸 Undivided Melee Attack - 25%
🔸 Undivided Melee Damage - 10%

A new Champion Skill is also being added to the Champion Tree, 'Chaos Plate', which improves Undivided Armour by 10%.


[b]Imperial Armour Event Update[/b]

Three new pieces of gear will be added to the Imperial Armour event! These items are part of a new set that boosts Research Speed, and the new required components to craft this set can be found in the existing Imperial Armour challenge rewards.


[b]New Ritual[/b]

A new Ritual will be added to further increase the training capacity of the Beastmen Herdstone!


[b]Unit Changes[/b]

[i]Screamers of Tzeentch -[/i] Melee Attack from 38 to 42. Melee Damage from 1150 to 1200.

[i]Kaldour’s Knights -[/i] Melee Attack from 36 to 40. Melee Damage from 1050 to 1100. Armour from 44 to 46. Health from 970 to 1100.

[i]Skin Wolves -[/i] Armour from 38 to 40. Melee Damage from 1250 to 1350.

[i]Skull Cannons of Khorne -[/i] Ranged Attack from 48 to 51.

[i]Boiling Brass -[/i] Melee damage from 950 to 1200

[i]Daemon Prince of Tzeentch -[/i] Melee Damage from 700 to 900. Ranged Damage from 700 to 1000. Ranged Attack from 40 to 42.

[i]Skullcrusher of Khorne -[/i] Armour from 53 to 55.


[b]Fortress Level Increases[/b]

A number of core structures will have their maximumlevels increased to 35, these are:

🔸 Chaos Keep
🔸 Lumber Mill
🔸 Slaughter Pens
🔸 Blast Furnace
🔸 Quarry
🔸 Warehouse
🔸 Fortress Walls

And, six further structures will have their maximum level increased from 30 to 32! These are:

🔸 Chaos Warshrine
🔸 Sorcerer’s Citadel
🔸 Capture Pit
🔸 Hellcannon
🔸 Daemonic Forge
🔸 Beastmen Herdstone


[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved hero loadout swapping by doing it in a single command. Prevents network loss from leaving the hero with no items equipped.
[*] Added missing premium purchase pop up when pressing recommended speed up quantity button.
[*] You can no longer send another scout march to a destination that you are currently scouting.
[*] If you search for a location, and it's not within the search radius, you can now search the entire map to find spawns.
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the delay timer for keep skins would re-enable if a flood error was encountered when switching keep skins too quickly
[*] Fixed a bug where if you had a march on its way to a destination and an enemy also sent a march after you did then you never got a free recall.
[/list]

[b]Future Updates[/b]

We’re excited to announce that the next new faction joining the battle for the 'Old World' in Chaos and Conquest will be the [b]Vampire Counts[/b], more details will be coming soon!

We hope you enjoy the game update. Happy Conquering! 💀

notes.title: June Development Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Mighty Lords! Today we’re sharing details about the next new structure for Chaos and Conquest. As mentioned earlier this year, we are working on a list of highly requested 'quality of life' features alongside new content, and we’ll be sharing some previews in the next blog in a few week's time. Today we’d like to show you the new trading structure that we mentioned earlier this year - the Raider’s Market! This structure has a large array of items for trade and, unlike other structures, does not need to be upgraded to access its full potential.

At the Raider’s Market, players will be able to trade their excess components for a variety of useful items such as Warlord Favour, Shields, Boosts, Resources, Mission Refreshes, Stamina Potions, VIP Time and more. The items available to purchase will rotate each day within the Raider’s Market, and each day a different component will be used to make these exchanges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/c10629b74ea96fdceeca7c666322297373dda771.png[/img]

For example, one day it could be ‘Offerings of Skulls’ available for trade and throughout the day you could trade these for the above items, and the following day it could be Vessels of Wrath. Initially, all existing structure and unit components will be potentially used in Raider’s trades, so make sure you check the market daily. This feature will allow players who have a surplus of these inventory items for more valuable resources and loot. 

We expect the next game update in around a month's time, and we’ll be sharing more of what to expect in the coming weeks! We hope you enjoyed this sneak peak at the Raider's Market.

• Warlord Crate -> Ruinous Warlord Chest

notes.title: November 2020 Development Blog
notes.notes:
We originally announced that the second part of the Invasion of Ulthuan would be launched in November. Unfortunately, due to circumstances beyond our control, we have to delay this update until early December. Our team have worked extremely hard to resolve existing issues in RvR and carry out other essential fixes, which we believe will also make this new update run as smoothly as possible. We do apologize for the delay and we appreciate your patience in the run-up to this long-awaited campaign.

[h2]Campaign Expansion - Invasion of Ulthuan. [/h2]

The forces of Chaos have finished constructing their invasion fleet at Blackclaw Port on the South-Western edge of Norsca, near the channel to the Sea of Claws. From this port, players will be able to launch the Invasion of Ulthuan. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/3b9b14b9be18bb9380b827ad91be6d9ffbfae6a7.jpg[/img]

To conquer the realm of Ulthuan, Alliances will need to work together to bring down these Strongholds and occupy them for a period of time. Ulthuan is around 1 third of the size of the ‘Old World’ so there’s plenty of room for players to Invade with their alliances and work towards ultimate victory.

When the Invasion of Ulthuan begins, access to the Ulthuan region will unlock for a period of 60 hours, beginning on Friday at noon (server time) and running until Sunday at Midnight. Players and alliances from every region will clash within Ulthuan in a true all-out war gameplay to see which Alliance truly is the most powerful in the game.

Within Ulthuan we’ll have both high-level armies & foes and the zone will very much be aimed at players of keep 15 or higher. Completing the new Alliance based quests will grant your alliance rare caches containing some other new rewards, such as: Uthilmar shards used in crafting a new set - ‘The Elfslayer’, or Corrupted Wayshards which will be used in a new ‘Corrupted Elven’ Keep Skin, and then there will be new types of gathering node for the Silver Leaf currency.

The rewards for participating within the Invasion of Ulthuan will include new equipment, keep skins, Alliance gifts and more! We’re also including the following new content in this update and we are currently planning to launch this patch the first week of December.

[h2]New Legendary Warlord - Sigvald the Magnificent[/h2]
Prince Sigvald is the most infamous of Slaanesh's favoured Champions, a legend in battlefield prowess and his beauty is both disturbing yet angelic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/89a2b7e3bf4ef94070969f1f665076a18a1aeb8a.jpg[/img]

Sigvald will arrive soon and move across the Old World in the Prince of the Decadent Host event, allowing players to earn his allegiance in battle. Defeating Sigvald in a new Infernal Defeat Slaanesh Foes challenge will reward both tier 4 and 5 troop components, along with a Legendary Warlord cache.

[h2]New Defenses[/h2]

This update also includes 3 new defences at tier 4, which can be unlocked by a new ritual within the faction trees. These defences focus on the Dark Gods which previously didn’t have a defence at tier 4.

[h3]The Fetid Moat (Nurgle)[/h3]
Encircling the Fortress, these moats are filled with the vile and fecund bounties of Grandfather Nurgle, gifting them upon those who fall in, with supernatural decay setting in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/70ccb9125b12b1fd383c29dc1811a3c362cddcb1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Skull Mortar (Khorne)[/h3]
Vast mortars of blood stained iron, Skull Mortars lob huge flaming brass shells. They detonate with explosive force, scything down their victims.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/8fa92e5354cf9ed082a4fff8bbcf5f4bc270bc5c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Flame Gargoyles (Tzeentch)[/h3]
Gargoyles perched all around the Fortress, these immobile statues spring to life in the presence of enemies, dousing them with mutating, corrosive fire!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/67cabf31d31a6a284d8747246fcf02d895296937.jpg[/img]

[h2]Teleport Changes[/h2]

With the release of Region vs Region and the upcoming release of Ulthuan a lot of the bugs, lag and disconnects we’ve experienced have been due to our teleportation mechanic. 

As we instantly resolve incoming marches and there is no limit on the number of marches we may have to resolve the use of a teleport puts a heavy load on the system. In addition to this it can also cause confusion when one of the marches destroys the teleporting player, causing them to double teleport or sometimes even get their Champion captured (and returned if you’re leaving the region) in a single event.

As such we’ll be making a change to the Teleport items. You will no longer be able to use a Teleport item while any hostile march is targeting your Fortress. Friendly marches will also no longer instant resolve, they’ll turn around and go home.

A new ‘Flee’ item for a cost of 950 Warpstone or 200k Alliance Coins will be made available. This item works almost identically to a teleport; however, this CAN be used when hostile marches are incoming and this item will dodge them, very similar to if a player were to use a shield then teleport. 

Returning home from an Invasion or from the Ulthuan region will count as fleeing for the purposes of march resolution. Note that you still won’t actually need to use an item or pay to return from another region, but the mechanic will work in the same way.

The new flee teleport will be blocked anywhere you cannot use a shield. (ie. when owning an Empire/Elven City or are in a Siege Zone) Finally, you will not be able to invade an enemy region while you have incoming hostile marches.

[h2]RvR Fixes[/h2]

We’ve also fixed a bug that caused the game to confuse the Fortress and Empire City coordinates, preventing the creation of Warbands against the City with incorrect errors regarding shields and alliance membership. This goes alongside the hotfix we pushed out last time to stop players sending Warbands against an enemy city locked by invaders and showing as on fire.

[h2]Community[/h2]

Finally, our community team has started collecting questions for the next round of Q & A with the development team, so if you have a burning question please head over to the new #community-questions Discord room!

We hope you are all ready to join the ‘Invasion of Ulthuan’ very soon!

notes.title: Development Blog: February 2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/97f5f145f6442d7fb73f7fc801ab3709ef45a83e.png[/img]

[h2][b][u]DEVELOPMENT BLOG: FEBRUARY 2020[/u][/b][/h2]

Greetings, Lords of Chaos!

Here is the highly requested development update! We have a lot to share about the next game update, so let’s dive in!

[h3][b]Fortress Skins[/b][/h3]

Backed by popular demand, Fortress Skins will allow players to change their Fortress’s appearance on the world map! The system will launch with 5 skins (including the current Undivided appearance). Each skin will bring new buffs to your Fortress, these range from Ritual and Healing Speed, to Maximum Stamina and March Capacity.

The following skins will be available initially:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/62a4015a8f6df4e681ab0404f8ef85b3c409405a.jpg[/img]
[b]Blood Bastion (Khorne)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/334676b8f89aafbb848befea24f89d67b7681e16.jpg[/img]
[b]Palace of Rapture (Slaanesh)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/eecbe5845b51591789260ddc4f5d0b26dcf2ed2d.jpg[/img]
[b]Shifting Spire (Tzeentch)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/f3a8274adcf64549b55e092341b9baa707daa864.jpg[/img]
[b]Blighted Stronghold (Nurgle)[/b]

A new currency will be added for the players to collect and upgrade the power of the new Fortress Skins, this will be Daemonic Fulgurites.

[h3][b]Unit Balance[/b][/h3]

We’ve been listening to all your feedback about various unit strengths and weaknesses and we’re looking to increase the power of 6 different units in the next patch, but in the patches beyond we’ll continue to improve and balance other units and we’re also planning to improve a number of Warlords to bring them more into the meta.

[h3][b]Infernal and Legion Challenges[/b][/h3]

Two new types of Challenge will be coming to the game. Infernal Challenges will be extremely tough challenges which run for a short period of time, they focus on PvE targets such as gaining power or training troops and players can earn large numbers of renown units and huge amounts of Warpstone. The leaderboards in Infernal challenges are also game-w-ide, so you’ll be competing not just against players in your own region, but across all the regions of the Old World.

Legion Challenges are a new type of Alliance challenge in which the Alliance works together to gain each tier, rather than individually. Players will also be able to track which alliance members have contributed to the challenge via a new button in the challenge panel.

As well as this all challenges will now be moved to the improved reward tiers that you’ve seen on some challenges.

[h3][b]Healing Improvements[/b][/h3]

We’ve heard your feedback on healing, in the new update every level of the Sawbones has had it’s healing speed bonus increased and there’s a new type of Speed Up which only works on healing. These will be obtainable in new places and also for Chaos Shards.

[h3][b]Item Sets[/b][/h3]

We know some of you noticed the new item sets tab appear in the last update, Item Sets with set bonuses for collecting and equipping these items are coming. We’ve got 2 item sets in development, they are very close, so keep an eye out for them very soon.

[h3][b]Advanced Combat Breakdown[/b][/h3]

We’ve been working on a system for a while to allow players to see each turn of combat broken down into exactly who attacked who in a much more detailed way than the battle reports currently provide. We hope this will allow you more tactics and planning and every battle report will now include a button to see the breakdown, this will be available for both PvP and PvE army attacks.

All this will be coming to the game in around a month's time. 

[h3][b]Future Updates[/b][/h3]

At this week's ‘Ask Us Anything’ we had a number of questions about the future, the immediate patches and priorities for the team after the next update will be; the Empire City Domination challenge rework, Server vs Server and a new special seasonal map event.

[h3][b]Altdorf is Defeated!?! What’s Next[/b][/h3]

Well this is a good question really, there are many other feeble races across the Old World which stand against the forces of Chaos, however with the Empire all but conquered, the Lord’s of Chaos have their eyes set on an ancient enemy. Here’s a sneak peek at something we’re working on for an entirely new region!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/bc76a2d8abb8aa40066406642e7398c9bdc51b6c.jpg[/img]

We’ll continue to listen to your feedback this year and make further improvements to the game!

Enjoy a free Stamina potion on us by checking your reports in-game, and happy conquering!

notes.title: Development Blog: December 2019
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/69e176136989aaa752a9216e3a333cfa1d6f3206.png[/img]

[h2][u][b]DEVELOPMENT BLOG: DECEMBER 2019[/b][/u][/h2]

Greetings, Lords of Chaos!

As the Festive season approaches, we’d like to share with you some details of our development road map for 2020. But first, make sure you log in on Thursday the 19th of December, as we will be starting both the Winds of Winter Event and a special Dark Solstice Daily Reward Calendar! 

Now let's talk about 2020.

[h3][b]Tier 5 Units[/b][/h3]

We’re bringing four new Tier 5 units to the game. As the followers of Khorne already have some tier 5 troops, we’re adding the following:

[list]
[*] Burning Chariots of Tzeentch
[*] Hellflayers of Slaanesh
[*] Beasts of Nurgle
[*] Skin Wolves
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/b414ad3973d7a4fab1d91cd00b172a8a55637d14.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/0fa9107293b347fa8d3d3565d698817429e5bcc6.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Keep Skins[/b][/h3]

Backed by popular demand, we’re adding a new feature due early next year that will allow players to change their Keep’s appearance on the world map! Four new skins are in development; each one will bring new bonuses to your Fortresses and let you show your devotion to one of the four gods of Chaos! Here are the concept art pieces for each of the new skins coming in early 2020.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/1a8e2cc276fa979ef2b55a3911df2af540c662f6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/e92e0f3534e22a9429367e9ff24f204eb13b8603.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/c0547a908b55cb5248e87b27f72f924e8fa19aca.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/d3ff6405d2ee36743b649e3892c00843b4973910.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Foe Events[/b][/h3]

Steam Tanks will roll out across the lands of the Empire in a new Imperial Armour Foe event, dropping new equipment pieces and rare unit components.

The powerful Beastmen Centigors will be making their way across the Old World in a new Foe event, allowing players access to further new gear and materials.

[h3][b]New Warlord[/b][/h3]

The fourth greater Daemon will be joining the battle for the Old World next! Born of pure magic, a Lord of Change is a sorcerer beyond comparison. It blasts Tzeentch's foes with multicoloured bolts of mutating power!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/f0c1ee1573066bc7ff8d7330f926a9e17f9ec677.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Challenge Improvements[/b][/h3]

Our December update started looking at challenges in which players were finding it difficult to achieve the Gold tiers, and in some cases felt the rewards weren’t worthwhile. Well, we’ll be reviewing and improving both the requirements and rewards for many challenges in the coming months.

[h3][b]Empire Cities Challenge[/b][/h3]

We’re also looking at the Empire City Siege challenge. This is being reworked to be more engaging and rewarding for everyone, the rework will also featuring more reasons to fight and hold Landmarks, and we’ll be adding new item rewards to complete the Landmark item set.

[h3][b]Endgame Content[/b][/h3]

For our more powerful players, we have two new large pieces of content currently being worked on. The first is Region vs Region combat, where we will pit two regions against each other in an epic battle, featuring powerful rare rewards. 

The second will be an entirely new region featuring a new faction of enemies which haven’t yet been seen in Chaos and Conquest. We’ll be sharing more on this shortly, but work is already underway and we’re excited to reveal more in the new year!

[h3][b]Warlord Improvements[/b][/h3]

We’ve been reviewing your feedback on Warlords - which ones are used, which ones are popular and which ones you feel could be more useful - and as a result, we’re planning to improve the lower rarity Warlords to make them more competitive. We also have two more Epic Warlords and our first Legendary Warlords coming to the game! Teasers will be shared on our Facebook page in the run up to these being released!

[h3][b]Thanks for a great year![/b][/h3]

Finally, we'd like to thank all players who have jumped in and played the game this year. 2019 has been a very cool year for us and, with lots in store for the future, our journey has just begun! We hope you all have a very enjoyable winter and hope to see you all in the new year!

We’d also like to apologize for the problems with the PvP challenge that happened this weekend and we hope you accept these 1000 Warpstone in-game as compensation for this issue.

notes.title: Warhammer: Chaos & Conquest Now Available On Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/e121baa5b4b944aef48402b393c3d4573bed9064.png[/img]

Spread Chaos across the Old World! Command a horde as you build a fortress capable of conquering the Empire of Man – and any other Chaos warbands that stand in your way. With enough power, you will prove your worth to the Chaos Gods by conquering Altdorf and becoming the Everchosen!

Set in the Warhammer Fantasy universe, Warhammer: Chaos & Conquest is real-time massively multiplayer strategy game where players compete for the resources of the Old World and battle for control of the Old World.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/53aff185cb3bcd9111960b889a0aca2d77c2ccee.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Collect Warlords to be your most powerful soldiers in the war against the Empire
[*] Over 20 Daemons of Chaos & 10 Warriors of Chaos to collect
[*] Use your strategy to assemble a diverse warband capable of smashing the defenses of your foes
[*] Daily challenges to complete with guaranteed rewards & bonuses based on leaderboards!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/6af682e7ea797224c91f4881e1b3e0774a973175.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Raise a Champion worthy of the title of Everchosen
[*] Research Skills to expand your military, battle, & unholy might
[*] Increase your power by building structures including the Chaos Temple, Sorcerer’s Citadel, Fortress Walls, Watchtower, Warlord Conclave, Workshop, Daemonic Forge, Hell Cannons, Dungeons, Training Grounds, & more.
[*] Collect more resources by upgrading your Lumber Mill, Slaughter Pens, Blast Furnace, & Quarry
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/71672cf6fde411a8e69e8273b06abcf79e9a63ac.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Vanquish roaming beasts to send them to their final resting place
[*] Send your warriors on marches throughout the realm to pillage goods from the land
[*] Siege other players fortresses to muck up their plans of conquest in favour of your own
[*] World chat for discussing the battle results with your enemies!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/4c226a21f5122558b34237cf7ed55b5959c72489.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Join an alliance to coordinate the conquest of landmarks important to the Empire
[*] Share the spoils with your alliance! As your alliance collects resources, your allies automatically earn additional spoils
[*] Assist your allies by speeding up their construction of their Chaos Fortress
[*] Send your troops to assist your alliance in defense, or receive warriors from your allies to make your fortress unbeatable
[*] Complete Trials, both solo & with your alliance, to make your army more powerful
[*] Gather with your Alliance to take over the major landmarks of the Old World
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/2a823947dd26e7db8e04997cddeb1578ec769852.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Pledge your alliance to the Chaos Gods – Khorne, Nurgle, Tzeentch, & Slaanesh! Bring the chaos they desire to the Old World!
[*] Build a temple to Nurgle, the Plague Lord and god of disease, decay, and death!
[*] Build a Temple to the Dark Prince Slaanesh, the God of lust, pride, and decadence!
[*] Build a temple to the changer of Ways, Tzeentch, the god of magic, change, and sorcery!
[*] Construct a temple to the blood God Khorne! The god of violence, carnage, and anger is eager for the spill of blood.
[*] Special events to conquer roaming warbands of other Warhammer Fantasy factions, including greenskins, beastmen, & dwarfs!
[*] Iconic Warhammer Fantasy locations, including: Chaos Wastes, Norsca, Troll Country, & the Empire of Man
[*] Iconic Warhammer creatures to housing in your dungeons, including Chaos Spawn, Slaughter Brutes, mutalith vortex beasts, & dragon ogres!
[*] Iconic Warhammer infantry available for training, including Marauders, Forsaken, Chaos Warriors, & Chaos Chosen
[*] Iconic Warhammer beasts to corral, including: Warhounds, Chimera, Gorebeasts
[*] Collect warpstone through daily quests
[/list]

Carve your own legend in the Warhammer Fantasy Old World. The legions of the Empire of Man stand in your way – march your warband right through them & cement your legacy as the Everchosen of Chaos that brought down the Empire of Man!
